data.one_liner: An easy to use side menu navigation rail widget in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customisable side navigation menu component for Flutter applications. Supports Material 3 theming, glassmorphism, expansion items, badges, and responsive auto-collapse.
use_when: You need a sidebar navigation rail for desktop or tablet layouts.
You want customisable side navigation with M3 theming and zero external dependencies.
avoid_when: You are building a mobile-first app primarily using bottom navigation bars or standard drawers.
strengths: Highly customisable with M3 theming, glassmorphism, and decorations
Supports responsive auto-collapse and expansion items

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: For full URL-based routing and deep linking across screens rather than just a sidebar navigation widget.
